purpose: Persisted group chat with real Qwen planning, sequential specialist replies and Nubi synthesis
architecture: Bundled local WebView and validated native group bridge
Each specialist sees preceding replies; final Nubi call synthesizes
Request idempotency, per-device ownership, no automatic POST retries
Model credentials remain only on host; Android pairing encrypted in Keystore
scope: Real model conversation only. No browser/API tool execution, login, booking, transaction or external messaging in this group worker. Existing specialist workflows remain separately available.
preservation: 0.6.9 and 0.6.10 remain separate packages; prior 0.6.11 APK stored locally; groupchat updated to 0.6.12
evidence: Initial server responses were collected before prompt refinement to student-level support. Final phone responses use refined prompt. Captures and videos kept local.

verification.network: Authenticated TLS over WiFi; USB used for installation and instrumentation

known_quality_limitations: Compound response sometimes assigns a specialist the wrong domain.
Unverified travel times/station names appeared in generated planning text. Responses are not verified service results.
Earlier planner JSON failures fixed with constrained JSON schema; instrumentation timeout increased to 25 seconds.
